comment: Shadow-only loose policy for MLB/NFL. Three-source liquidity-weighted fair value required; Kalshi-only control retained. $500/$500/$1,000 contract/combo/fixture limits, $250 maximum gross ticket liability, exact moneyline offset risk netting without cash credit, 0.30c after-fee edge hurdle, zero reserve, and rejection of the frozen top-1% correlation-reserve tail. Unknown mappings, stale/disagreement inputs, and unreviewed Pinnacle selectors fail closed. Full-game moneyline Pinnacle mappings may use the rules-vetted adapter; all other families remain blocked. Observation-only player-prop mappings may be collected but never priced.

observation_scope.purpose: collect market books and RFQ opportunity diagnostics; never enters fair value or combo pricing
